const fs = require('fs'), path = require('path');
function findRoot(d) {
  while (d !== path.dirname(d)) {
    if (fs.existsSync(path.join(d,'pnpm-workspace.yaml'))) return d;
    d = path.dirname(d);
  }
  throw new Error('no monorepo root');
}

}]);};`;

const { withDangerousMod } = require('@expo/config-plugins');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const MARKER = '[iOS26-ObjCTurboModule-patch]';
const RUBY_LINES = [
  '',
  '  # ' + MARKER + ' prevent backtrace_symbols stack overflow on iOS 26',
  '  Dir.glob(File.join(installer.sandbox.root.to_s, "**", "ObjCTurboModule.mm")).each do |f|',
  '    src = File.read(f)',
  '    orig = "NSArray<NSString *> *callStackSymbols = exception.callStackSymbols;"',
  '    fixed = "NSArray<NSString *> *callStackSymbols = @[]; // iOS 26 fix"',
  '    next unless src.include?(orig)',
  '    File.write(f, src.sub(orig, fixed))',
  '    puts "[iOS26] Patched ObjCTurboModule.mm at " + f',
  '  end',
  '',
].join('\n');

module.exports = function withObjCTurboModulePatch(config) {
  return withDangerousMod(config, [
    'ios',
    async function (config) {
      const platformRoot = config.modRequest && config.modRequest.platformProjectRoot;
      if (!platformRoot) return config;
      const podfilePath = path.join(platformRoot, 'Podfile');
      if (!fs.existsSync(podfilePath)) return config;
      const contents = fs.readFileSync(podfilePath, 'utf-8');
      if (contents.indexOf(MARKER) !== -1) return config;
      const lastEnd = contents.lastIndexOf('\nend');
      if (lastEnd === -1) return config;
      const patched = contents.slice(0, lastEnd) + RUBY_LINES + contents.slice(lastEnd);
      fs.writeFileSync(podfilePath, patched, 'utf-8');
      console.log('[withObjCTurboModulePatch] Patched Podfile post_install');
      return config;
    },
  ]);
};
PLUGINEOF

  '  Dir.glob(File.join(installer.sandbox.root.to_s, "**", "ObjCTurboModule.mm")).each do |f|',
  '    src = File.read(f)',
  '    orig = "NSArray<NSString *> *callStackSymbols = exception.callStackSymbols;"',
  '    fixed = "NSArray<NSString *> *callStackSymbols = @[]; // iOS 26 fix"',
  '    next unless src.include?(orig)',
  '    File.write(f, src.sub(orig, fixed))',
  '    puts "[iOS26] Patched ObjCTurboModule.mm at " + f',
  '  end',
  '',
].join('\n');

async function applyPodfilePatch(config) {
  try {
    var req = config.modRequest;
    if (!req || !req.platformProjectRoot) return config;
    var podfilePath = path.join(req.platformProjectRoot, 'Podfile');
    if (!fs.existsSync(podfilePath)) return config;
    var contents = fs.readFileSync(podfilePath, 'utf-8');
    if (contents.indexOf(MARKER) !== -1) return config;
    var lastEnd = contents.lastIndexOf('\nend');
    if (lastEnd === -1) return config;
    var patched = contents.slice(0, lastEnd) + RUBY_LINES + contents.slice(lastEnd);
    fs.writeFileSync(podfilePath, patched, 'utf-8');
    console.log('[withObjCTurboModulePatch] Patched Podfile post_install hook');
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('[withObjCTurboModulePatch] Skipped:', e.message);
  }
  return config;
}

module.exports = function withObjCTurboModulePatch(config) {
  if (!config.mods) config.mods = {};
  if (!config.mods.ios) config.mods.ios = {};
  var prev = config.mods.ios.dangerous;
  config.mods.ios.dangerous = prev
    ? async function(c) { return applyPodfilePatch(await prev(c)); }
    : applyPodfilePatch;
  return config;
};

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const MARKER = '[iOS26-fix]';
const RELEASE_ENV_LINE = "ENV['CONFIGURATION'] = 'Release' # " + MARKER + ' force release RN tarball\n';
const RUBY_PATCH_LINES = [
  '  # ' + MARKER + ' patch ObjCTurboModule.mm if building from source',
  '  Dir.glob(File.join(installer.sandbox.root.to_s, "**", "ObjCTurboModule.mm")).each do |f|',
  '    src = File.read(f)',
  '    orig = "NSArray<NSString *> *callStackSymbols = exception.callStackSymbols;"',
  '    fixed = "NSArray<NSString *> *callStackSymbols = @[]; // iOS 26 fix"',
  '    next unless src.include?(orig)',
  '    File.write(f, src.sub(orig, fixed))',
  '    puts "[iOS26] Patched ObjCTurboModule.mm at " + f',
  '  end',
].join('\n');
async function applyPodfilePatch(config) {
  try {
    var req = config.modRequest;
    if (!req || !req.platformProjectRoot) return config;
    var podfilePath = path.join(req.platformProjectRoot, 'Podfile');
    if (!fs.existsSync(podfilePath)) return config;
    var contents = fs.readFileSync(podfilePath, 'utf-8');
    if (contents.indexOf(MARKER) !== -1) { console.log('[iOS26] Already patched'); return config; }
    var requireEnd = contents.indexOf('\n\n');
    contents = requireEnd !== -1
      ? contents.slice(0, requireEnd + 2) + RELEASE_ENV_LINE + contents.slice(requireEnd + 2)
      : RELEASE_ENV_LINE + contents;
    console.log('[iOS26] Added ENV CONFIGURATION=Release');
    var postInstallIdx = contents.search(/post_install\s+do\s+\|installer\|/);
    if (postInstallIdx !== -1) {
      var lastEndInBlock = contents.slice(postInstallIdx).lastIndexOf('\nend');
      if (lastEndInBlock !== -1) {
        var at = postInstallIdx + lastEndInBlock;
        contents = contents.slice(0, at) + '\n' + RUBY_PATCH_LINES + contents.slice(at);
        console.log('[iOS26] Injected into existing post_install');
      }
    } else {
      contents += '\npost_install do |installer|\n' + RUBY_PATCH_LINES + '\nend\n';
      console.log('[iOS26] Added new post_install block');
    }
    fs.writeFileSync(podfilePath, contents, 'utf-8');
    console.log('[iOS26] Podfile written');
  } catch (e) { console.warn('[iOS26] Error:', e.message); }
  return config;
}
module.exports = function withObjCTurboModulePatch(config) {
  if (!config.mods) config.mods = {};
  if (!config.mods.ios) config.mods.ios = {};
  var prev = config.mods.ios.dangerous;
  config.mods.ios.dangerous = prev
    ? function(c) { return prev(c).then(applyPodfilePatch); }
    : applyPodfilePatch;
  return config;
};

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const MARKER = '[iOS26-fix]';
async function applyPodfilePatch(config) {
  try {
    var req = config.modRequest;
    if (!req || !req.platformProjectRoot) return config;
    var podfilePath = path.join(req.platformProjectRoot, 'Podfile');
    if (!fs.existsSync(podfilePath)) return config;
    var contents = fs.readFileSync(podfilePath, 'utf-8');
    if (contents.indexOf(MARKER) !== -1) return config;
    var RELEASE_LINE = "ENV['CONFIGURATION'] = 'Release' # " + MARKER + '\n';
    var firstBlank = contents.indexOf('\n\n');
    contents = firstBlank !== -1
      ? contents.slice(0, firstBlank + 2) + RELEASE_LINE + contents.slice(firstBlank + 2)
      : RELEASE_LINE + contents;
    fs.writeFileSync(podfilePath, contents, 'utf-8');
    console.log('[iOS26] Added ENV CONFIGURATION=Release to Podfile');
  } catch (e) { console.warn('[iOS26] Plugin error (non-fatal):', e.message); }
  return config;
}
module.exports = function withObjCTurboModulePatch(config) {
  if (!config.mods) config.mods = {};
  if (!config.mods.ios) config.mods.ios = {};
  var prev = config.mods.ios.dangerous;
  config.mods.ios.dangerous = prev
    ? function(c) { return prev(c).then(applyPodfilePatch); }
    : applyPodfilePatch;
  return config;
};

// PushNotificationManager disabled — expo-notifications void calls and
// KeyboardProvider both throw NSException on iOS 26 + RN 0.81 New Architecture.

function RootLayoutNav() {
  return (
    <>
      <AuthTokenSetter />
      <ProjectProvider>
        <Stack screenOptions={{ headerBackTitle: 'Back' }}>
          <Stack.Screen name="(tabs)" options={{ headerShown: false }} />
          <Stack.Screen name="(auth)" options={{ headerShown: false }} />
          <Stack.Screen name="index" options={{ headerShown: false }} />
        </Stack>
      </ProjectProvider>
    </>
  );
}

export default function RootLayout() {
  const [fontsLoaded, fontError] = useFonts({
    Inter_400Regular,
    Inter_500Medium,
    Inter_600SemiBold,
    Inter_700Bold,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (fontsLoaded || fontError) {
      setTimeout(() => SplashScreen.hideAsync(), 2500);
    }
  }, [fontsLoaded, fontError]);

  if (!fontsLoaded && !fontError) return null;

  if (!CLERK_KEY || !CLERK_KEY.startsWith('pk_')) {
    SplashScreen.hideAsync();
    return (
      <View style={{ flex: 1, alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', padding: 24, backgroundColor: '#fff' }}>
        <Text style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: '700', color: '#c0392b', marginBottom: 12 }}>
          Missing Clerk Key
        </Text>
        <Text style={{ fontSize: 14, color: '#333', textAlign: 'center' }}>
          EXPO_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY was not set at build time.{'\n\n'}
          Rebuild with:{'\n'}
          {'EXPO_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=pk_live_… eas build --local …'}
        </Text>
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <ClerkProvider publishableKey={CLERK_KEY} tokenCache={tokenCache}>
      <SafeAreaProvider>
        <ErrorBoundary>
          <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
            <GestureHandlerRootView style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              {/* KeyboardProvider disabled — see comment above */}
              <RootLayoutNav />
            </GestureHandlerRootView>
          </QueryClientProvider>
        </ErrorBoundary>
      </SafeAreaProvider>
    </ClerkProvider>
  );
}

stevenstec@MacBook-Pro-4 Construction-Ledger-3 % async function handleShare() {
  if (!project) return;
  setSharing(true);
  try {
    let token = (project as any).shareToken as string | null | undefined;
    if (!token) {
      const authToken = await getToken();
      const resp = await fetch(
        `https://${process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_DOMAIN}/api/projects/${project.id}/share`,
        { method: 'POST', headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${authToken}` } }
      );
      const data = await resp.json();
      token = data.shareToken;
    }
    const shareUrl = `https://${process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_DOMAIN}/client/${token}`;
    await Share.share({
      message: `View the project portal for ${project.name}: ${shareUrl}`,
      url: shareUrl,
    });
  } catch {
    Alert.alert('Share failed', 'Could not generate a share link. Please try again.');
  } finally {
    setSharing(false);
  }
}
